notes.title: Introduction to Python
notes: Python is a general-purpose programming language.
Programs are written as instructions for the computer.
Variables allow us to store values.
Functions allow us to reuse instructions.

notes.title: Introduction to Mathematics
notes: Mathematics studies numbers, quantities, patterns and relationships.
Arithmetic includes addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
Equations use mathematical symbols to describe relationships.

notes.title: Introduction to Physics
notes: Physics studies matter, energy, motion and forces.
Measurements are used to describe physical quantities.
Forces can change the motion of objects.
